europe_now.title: Kyiv Power Plant Hit by Missile Attack
europe_now.summary: A critical power plant in Kyiv sustained a direct hit from a Russian missile without prior warning from regional allies. The strike highlights ongoing vulnerabilities in Ukraine's energy infrastructure amid intensified regional conflict.

europe_now.title: Arrest Made in Polish Prime Minister Assassination Plot
europe_now.summary: Law enforcement authorities have charged a man suspected of plotting a targeted attack against the Polish prime minister. The security incident underscores heightened political tensions within Central Europe.

top_stories.title: Escalating Student Demonstrations Across France
top_stories.summary: Tens of thousands of students participated in widespread rallies throughout France to protest educational conditions and government policies. Demonstrators in Paris engaged in continuous actions while calling for greater administrative attention.

top_stories.title: Spanish Monarchy Reasserts Sovereignty Over Ceuta
top_stories.summary: The King of Spain traveled to Ceuta to emphasize that the territory's sovereignty and territorial integrity remain absolute. The high-profile visit unfolded against a backdrop of ongoing diplomatic friction concerning migration inflows.
